name: Alafija VA25
description: lift+cruise quadplane, 4 lift rotors + pusher, 11.0 kg MTOW, 2.0 kg max payload. Parameters derived from published data; see provenance.

provenance.wind_rating_beaufort: referenced — level 6 wind resistance. Beaufort 6 is a band; the limit is read at its lower edge
provenance.m_tow: derived — 13.0 kg MTOW minus 2.0 kg payload = 11.00 kg empty. RAPTOR adds payload on top of this, so the field holds the empty mass, not the MTOW
provenance.S_ref: derived — b^2/AR with b = 2.5 m (referenced) and AR = 8.5 (assumed), giving 0.735 m^2 and a mean chord of 0.294 m
provenance.AR: assumed — 8.5, read from the airframe's proportions; not published. Wing loading follows at 15.0 kg/m^2, which is the number to sanity-check
provenance.n_rotors: referenced — 4, from the published configuration (lift+cruise quadplane, 4 lift rotors + pusher)
provenance.rotor_diameter_m: assumed — 0.559 m (22 in), the usual size for this mass class; not published. Gives a disk loading of 11.2 kg/m^2 against the 5-15 kg/m^2 that multirotors of this class run
provenance.rotor_parking: referenced — aligned — follows from the configuration, not a free choice
provenance.cell_chemistry: referenced — li-ion-semisolid — from the pack the manufacturer specifies
provenance.cell_capacity_ah: assumed — 4.2 Ah — the manufacturer does not say which cell the pack is built from, so a Molicel INR21700-P42A is assumed. It implies 6.4 parallel strings, which is what divides the pack's internal resistance
provenance.battery_mass: derived — 1211 Wh at 226 Wh/kg pack level = 5.36 kg, which is 41% of the 13.0 kg MTOW. That is 4.66 kg of cells plus 15% for wiring, BMS and case
provenance.specific_energy: derived — 226 Wh/kg at pack level = 260 Wh/kg of cells divided by 1 + 0.15 of overhead
provenance.battery_capacity_mah: derived — none of the listed options (30 Ah) fits inside the published 11.00 kg empty mass once pack overhead is counted; 26.9 Ah is what the budget allows — 26.9 Ah, giving 1211 Wh at a 3.749 V measured mean cell open-circuit voltage
provenance.cell_internal_resistance_ohm: assumed — 25 mOhm DC for one Molicel INR21700-P42A. Over 12S6.4P that is 47 mOhm at the pack, which sets voltage sag at hover current. Measure it if the pack is in hand
provenance.eta_cruise: assumed — 0.72, a dedicated pusher propeller sized for cruise
provenance.eta_vtol: assumed — 0.62, motor x ESC x propeller in the hover working point
provenance.geometry.fuselage_diameter: derived — 0.234 m, from the 2.0 kg payload's bulk at a cold-chain packing density; not published
provenance.geometry.boom_length: assumed — 1.375 m, 55% of span — the rotors sit outboard of the fuselage but well inboard of the tips
provenance.geometry.tail_area: assumed — 0.0809 m^2, 11% of wing area (horizontal plus vertical), a conventional tail volume for this layout
